data_points.name: Article / SKU number
data_points.description: Unique product code that every packaging record links to.

data_points.name: GTIN / barcode
data_points.description: Global trade item number, used to match the product across systems and on the data carrier.

data_points.name: Packaging component list
data_points.description: Every component of the pack: bottle, closure, label, carton, case, film.
data_points.system_field: SAP bill of materials · STKO / STPO

data_points.name: Packaging level
data_points.description: Whether each component is primary, secondary or transit packaging.

data_points.name: Units per pack
data_points.description: How many sales units share a secondary or transit component.

data_points.name: Component material
data_points.description: Main material of each component (glass, aluminium, paper/board, plastic, steel, wood, other).

data_points.name: Polymer type
data_points.description: Plastic type for plastic components (PET, HDPE, PP, LDPE).

data_points.name: Multi-material split
data_points.description: Share of each material in composite components, by weight.

data_points.name: Component weight (empty)
data_points.description: Weight of each empty component in grams.

data_points.name: Colour and opacity
data_points.description: Colour and opacity of each component, which affect sorting and recycling.

data_points.name: Additives, inks and adhesives
data_points.description: Additives, inks, coatings and adhesives that can disrupt recycling.

data_points.name: Recyclability result
data_points.description: Result of the recyclability assessment for each component.

data_points.name: Recycled content %
data_points.description: Share of recycled material in each component.

data_points.name: Recycled content certificate
data_points.description: Chain-of-custody evidence for the recycled content claimed.

data_points.name: Reusable or single-use
data_points.description: Whether the packaging is designed to be reused.

data_points.name: Food-contact packaging
data_points.description: Whether the component is in contact with the product.

data_points.name: PFAS declaration
data_points.description: Supplier confirmation that food-contact components meet the PFAS limits.

data_points.name: Heavy metals
data_points.description: Combined lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium content.

data_points.name: Substances of concern
data_points.description: Screening for substances of concern in each component.

data_points.name: Minimisation evidence
data_points.description: Why the pack cannot be lighter or smaller (functional constraints).

data_points.name: Empty space ratio
data_points.description: Empty space in grouped, transport and e-commerce packaging.

data_points.name: Units placed on the market
data_points.description: Number of sales units supplied in the country during the period.
data_points.system_field: SAP billing · VBRP quantity by country

data_points.name: Sales channel
data_points.description: Whether units go to households (retail) or businesses (on-trade).

data_points.name: Delivery nation
data_points.description: England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland.

data_points.name: Exports out of the country
data_points.description: Units shipped out of the country, which are removed from the obligation.

data_points.name: Deposit scheme status
data_points.description: Whether the drinks container is in a deposit return scheme.

data_points.name: Import country of origin
data_points.description: Country the packaged product was imported from.

data_points.name: Producer role
data_points.description: Brand owner, packer/filler or importer for each product.

data_points.name: EPR registration number
data_points.description: The producer's registration number in the national register.

data_points.name: Compliance scheme membership
data_points.description: The scheme or PRO the producer belongs to in the country.

data_points.name: Authorised representative
data_points.description: EU representative for EPR where the producer is not established in the country.

data_points.name: Organisation size and thresholds
data_points.description: Turnover and tonnage that decide which obligations apply.

data_points.name: Reporting period
data_points.description: The period the report covers.

data_points.name: Declaration of Completeness
data_points.description: Annual declaration audited by an approved expert, if thresholds are exceeded.

data_points.name: Triman logo and Info-tri
data_points.description: French sorting logo and sorting instructions on the pack.

data_points.name: Environmental label codes
data_points.description: Material identification codes and sorting information on the pack.

data_points.name: CONAI plastic band
data_points.description: Contribution band for plastic packaging, based on sortability and recyclability.

data_points.name: Non-recycled plastic weight
data_points.description: Weight of non-recycled plastic, used for the Spanish plastic tax.

data_points.name: Harmonised material label
data_points.description: EU label showing material composition and sorting.

data_points.name: QR code / data carrier
data_points.description: Digital information linked from the pack.

data_points.name: DoC reference and version
data_points.description: Reference of the Declaration of Conformity for the packaging.

data_points.name: Technical file references
data_points.description: Test reports, certificates and assessments behind the DoC.

data_points.name: Supplier per component
data_points.description: The supplier of each packaging component.

data_points.name: Weight source and sampling
data_points.description: Whether each weight was measured, supplier-provided or estimated, with sampling records.

data_points.name: Sign-off owner
data_points.description: Named person who approves each submission.

data_points.name: Unique product identifier
data_points.description: Unique ID that links the product to its passport, for example a GS1 Digital Link built from the GTIN with batch or serial number.
data_points.system_field: SAP material and batch · MARA-MATNR / MCH1-CHARG

data_points.name: Economic operator identifier
data_points.description: Unique ID of the company placing the product on the EU market (for example EORI or GLN).

data_points.name: Facility identifier
data_points.description: Unique ID of the site where the product is filled and packed (for example GLN).

data_points.name: Passport level
data_points.description: Whether one passport covers a model, a batch or each single item.

data_points.name: Carbon footprint
data_points.description: Carbon footprint per unit, if the delegated act asks for it.
data_points.system_field: LCA study · kg CO2e per unit

data_points.name: End-of-life information
data_points.description: Instructions for reuse, collection and recycling shown to the consumer.

data_points.name: Commodity code
data_points.description: Customs code (HS / CN) of the product.

data_points.name: Passport hosting and access
data_points.description: Who hosts the passport data, the backup copy, and which information is public or restricted.

data_points.name: DPP registry entry
data_points.description: Registration of the product identifier in the EU passport registry.

data_points.name: DoC manufacturer and signatory
data_points.description: The manufacturer responsible for the Declaration of Conformity (usually the brand owner) and the person authorised to sign it for them.
data_points.system_field: DoC record · manufacturer, signatory and role

data_points.name: Document retention period
data_points.description: How long the DoC and technical file must be kept: 5 years after single-use packaging was last placed on the market, 10 years for reusable packaging.
